sections.title: The letter name
paragraphs: The letter name is (El) /ɛl/. Its main sound is the sound /l/ in the word (Lampe) /ˈlampə/, which means lamp. This letter makes only one sound in German.

sections.title: Making the sound
paragraphs: Press the tip of your tongue firmly against your upper gum ridge. Keep the back of your tongue low and flat. Let the air flow smoothly around the sides of your tongue. Your vocal cords vibrate. Put a hand on your throat to feel the gentle buzz.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: This letter always makes the sound /l/ in German. You hear this sound at the beginning, in the middle, and at the end of words. Double letters also make this exact same sound, as in the word (Ball) /bal/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: At the end of an English word like ball, you raise the back of your tongue. In German, never raise the back of your tongue. Always keep your tongue flat and clear, exactly like the first sound in light.
